description: Edit a language's user dictionary or the document's hyphenation exceptions: list the added and removed words, add or remove words (with ~ marking hyphenation points, e.g. "data~base"), or import or export a word list as a text file with one word per line (Edit > Spelling > User Dictionary; Import and Export)

language.description: Language name as InDesign shows it, such as "English: USA" or "German: 2006 Reform"

list.description: Added words, or removed words (words marked as not words, so they are flagged)

path.description: For import and export: a .txt word list, one word per line

target.description: The user dictionary, or the hyphenation exception list stored in the active document

words.description: For add and remove: the words

name: manage_user_dictionary
title: Manage User Dictionary
